entities.summary: André Laignel is a French politician. of the Socialist Party (PS) who has been serving as the mayor of Issoudun (1977-2026), first delegated vice-president of the Association of French Mayors (AMF) and the President of the Committee of Local Finances (CFL).

entities.summary: André Laignel is a French politician. of the Socialist Party (PS) who has been serving as the mayor of Issoudun (1977-2026), first delegated vice-president of the Association of French Mayors (AMF) and the President of the Committee of Local Finances (CFL).
